shared_elements: curvilinear/rounded motifs arranged in a horizontal row or band
justification: A depicts a monumental anthropomorphic figure covered in specific carved motifs (headdress bands, a prominent disc on the chest, curving arm and shoulder elements, a beaked bird-like form on the crown), whereas B shows only a horizontal band of repeated rounded/hand-like painted blobs along a low bench, with no figure, no body, no discrete identifiable creature. The only shared content is the generic presence of rounded shapes and a horizontal register of repeated motifs, which any tradition could produce independently.
